exclusions.source_text: Age ≤ 40 years of age, except the following subjects that must be \<18 years to enroll
Serum alanine aminotransferase (ALT) ≤5X upper limit of normal (ULN)
Ejection fraction ≥ 50% or shortening fraction of ≥ 24% on screening echocardiogram.
All females of childbearing potential must refrain from breastfeeding during study participation

exclusions.threshold: Direct bilirubin ≤ 3X upper limit of normal for age and institution
exclusions.source_text: Direct bilirubin ≤ 3X upper limit of normal for age and institution.

exclusions.threshold: ALT ≤5X ULN unless secondary to leukemic involvement
exclusions.source_text: Serum alanine aminotransferase (ALT) ≤5X upper limit of normal (ULN), unless deemed secondary to leukemic involvement in discussion with site PI.)

exclusions.threshold: Maximum prior cumulative doxorubicin dose ≤ 360 mg/m2
exclusions.source_text: Maximum prior cumulative doxorubicin dose ≤ 360 mg/m2 or equivalent
Patients known to have human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection; baseline testing for HIV is not required.
Pregnant or nursing women are excluded.
Individuals with a history of a different malignancy are ineligible except for the following circumstances:
Individuals with isolated CNS or testicular relapse.
